window_frame.note: Authored chrome. There is no original release to measure: the frame is a one-point box in the theme's border role with a small platform-facing corner radius, and its correctness is judged against the theme's own drawing rather than against a screenshot. Threading holds it with WindowChromeComponentTests' catalogue sweeps and its whole-window render.

title_bar.note: Authored chrome. The header row is flat ground closed by a one-point seam (the `rule` texture), which is a shared text-mode idiom rather than any one program's title bar.

window_buttons.note: Authored chrome. The `tui` caption family is hairline one-bit artwork in WindowChromeCaptionArtwork, inverted under the pointer. No historical system drew these; the bitmaps are the specification and the component tests pin them.

toolbar.note: Authored chrome, and the same answer every takeover gives: an app-drawn frame has no NSToolbar. The window's own controls live in WindowCommandBandView below the header row.

buttons.note: Authored chrome. Actions take the material's outlined primary treatment on square corners, which is the bracketed default action a text-mode program draws.

choice_controls.note: Authored chrome. Choosers stay the app's own chip at zero radius rather than borrowing a period well, because this theme states no bevel to seat one in.

fields.note: Authored chrome. A value well is stated darker than its panel (`fieldSurface`) rather than sunken by an edge, since depth here is carried by colour.

menus.note: Authored chrome. Menus keep the app's own grammar at zero radius; no historical menu family applies.

popovers.note: Authored chrome. Transient surfaces are stemless, flat-edged and shadowless (`textModePopoverStyle`): a box and its rule.

scrollbars.note: Authored chrome. The scroller stays `automatic`, which at zero radius is already a square track and thumb; none of the historical families are right for a drawn box.

lists_tables.note: Authored chrome. Rows use the app's own selection at zero radius, filled with the theme's single accent.

progress.note: Authored chrome. Progress stays continuous; the segmented Win32 block control belongs to that lineage, not to this idiom.

alerts_toasts.note: Authored chrome. Alerts take the same flat box as every other surface.

typography.note: Authored chrome. The face is the platform's own monospaced design (`typeface: .monospaced`) held slightly down in scale, not a period screen font that would need provenance.

icons.note: Authored chrome. The header row carries no application icon, and marks elsewhere stay the app's own symbols.
